descriptions.zh-Hans: 信使饭后画的土豆与勺子，土豆终于没有掉队。
descriptions.en: The messenger’s after-lunch sketch gives the potato a secure place on its spoon.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 旅途中自绘的面包菜单，黄油旁留了传递的空当。
descriptions.en: A handmade bread menu with room beside the butter for passing hands.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 信使自折的长袖纸页，展开才看得见小手。
descriptions.en: The messenger folded a paper sleeve with a hand hidden inside.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 信使折的两只纸鞋，都收在阴影色的小口袋里。
descriptions.en: Two paper shoes made by the messenger tuck into a shaded paper pocket.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 信使自制的纸勺托住一片纸面包，展开才看见碗沿的小弧线。
descriptions.en: The messenger’s paper spoon supports a piece of paper bread above a curved bowl rim.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 信使自制的翻卡，翻开袖口，两边各露出一只手。
descriptions.en: The messenger’s original folding card reveals hands when its paper cuffs turn back.
